description: This file implements resource grid mapping functions for 5G NR physical layer, including optimized mapping for contiguous DM-RS Type 1, resource element block mapping, and overall resource grid mapping with support for precoding, resource allocation, and pattern handling.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for resource grid mapping functions, including optimized DM-RS mapping and resource element block mapping.

methods.name: get_re_mask_type_1
methods.description: Returns resource element mask pattern for PDSCH DM-RS type 1 based on CDM group ID.

methods.name: map_dmrs_type1_contiguous
methods.description: Performs optimized mapping of contiguous DM-RS Type 1 symbols onto the resource grid, applying precoding and mapping REs to ports.

methods.name: map_re_block
methods.description: Maps a block of resource elements with precoding and layer mapping onto the resource grid.

methods.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl::resource_grid_mapper_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mapper with a channel precoder.

methods.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl::map
methods.description: Main function to map input REs onto the resource grid based on pattern, precoding, and allocation.

methods.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl::map
methods.description: Overloaded function to map symbols with resource allocation, reserved patterns, and re-skip handling.
